# Pixelate

**Distortion › Pixel** · v1.0.0 · 24 frames at 30 fps (10–60)

The picture breaks into growing blocks of pixels, swaps at the coarsest point, then sharpens into the new scene.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/pixelate@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Game and retro edits
- Censor-style jokes
- Digital themes

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import pixelate from './transitions/06-distortion/pixel/pixelate';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(pixelate, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 24 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `maxBlock` | integer | `96` | 8–240 | Largest block size in pixels. |
| `steps` | integer | `7` | 2–16 | Number of block sizes on the way up. |
